title: sdk: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity fixes and v1.110.1 bumps
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes:
- Unify auth/retries behavior across Python/TS/Go SDKs and improve streaming ergonomics.
- Parity fixes for streaming event shapes and error propagation.
- Bump SDK versions to v1.110.1 for Python/TS/Go.
- No breaking API changes expected; minor ergonomics improvements and bug fixes.
description:
Motivation: We have been shipping incremental parity updates across our SDKs and several teams reported inconsistent auth retry behavior and subtle differences in streaming event ergonomics between Python, TypeScript, and Go. This PR consolidates the shared auth+retry approach, harmonizes streaming callback/event shapes, applies small ergonomics improvements, and bumps stable SDK versions to v1.110.1.

What this changes (summary):
- Core: Centralize auth token refresh + retry policy into shared flavor (same retry backoff and error classification across SDKs).
- Streaming: Standardize streaming event envelope and callback ergonomics (on_start, on_partial, on_done, on_error) and add explicit close semantics to avoid dangling goroutines/async generators.
- Language parity: Align TypeScript and Go names/option flags with Python where it made sense (preserve idiomatic surface while keeping wire parity).
- Tests: Add cross-sdk integration tests for interrupted streams, transient auth failures, and long-poll cancellations.
- Release: Bump package versions to v1.110.1 and update changelogs.

Checklist: [x] Unit tests added/updated [x] Integration tests for streaming/retries [x] Docs updated in SDK CHANGELOGs [x] Verified playground examples for streaming in TS/Python/Go [x] CI green and flaky checks re-run

Notes: There were a few trade-offs to keep each SDK idiomatic: Go exposes a Context-first cancellation pattern, TS keeps promise/async-iterable ergonomics, and Python keeps generator + async generator compatibility. All SDKs now document the unified retry semantics and show recommended patterns for handling partial responses and resumable streams.

Linear: ENG-1420 (unify sdk auth/retries), ENG-1387 (streaming ergonomics parity).
